post.title: Free Google Search made $224.5 billion in 2025. Here's how
post.ig:
Free Google Search made $224.5 billion in 2025.

That's Google's Search & other revenue in Alphabet's 2025 annual report, about $615 million a day.
Advertisers bid to show ads next to your search, often paying per click.
April to June 2026: Search & other rose 17% to $63.3 billion.
Google paid Apple about $20 billion in 2022 to be Safari's default search engine.

Sources: Alphabet 2025 Form 10-K, Alphabet Q2 2026 results, US v. Google court records.
News and education, not financial advice.

Google Search is free to use, yet Google's Search & other revenue was $224.5 billion in 2025 (Alphabet 2025 Form 10-K), about $615 million a day, and it rose 17% to $63.3 billion from April to June 2026. Advertisers bid to show ads next to searches, and Google paid Apple about $20 billion in 2022 to be Safari's default search engine (US v. Google court records).

News and education, not financial advice.
